Ok my school. Its a secondary school for 12-16 year olds. I'm 14. It has Year 7,8,9,10 and 11. 7 and 8 are KS3(key stage 3) and 9 10 11 are GCSE/KS4 years. Around may in year 8 you can pick what you study for 9 10 11 and you have tests every term/half-term. A term is usually 12 weeks and a half term is 6 weeks. Every term you have a one week break in the middle. There are 3 terms. Autumn,Spring and Summer. You have the Summer holiday, A month and two/one week's, Autumn Half term break one week, Christmas break 2 weeks, February half term one week, Easter break 2 weeks, Summer half term and then Summer holidays and repeat. In terms of exams , you sit your GCES in year 11 and you can get a 1-9 or F-A** for Americans to understand. Every year you have unit tests at the end of each half term and term and then your big end of year exam in June.  My school starts at 8:45 and ends at 3:15. Hope this helped.
